name: Should I choose an attached, detached, or garage conversion ADU for rental purposes?
description: The choice depends on property layout, budget, and privacy needs; detached units offer more privacy, while garage conversions are more budget-friendly.

mainEntity.name: Should I choose an attached, detached, or garage conversion ADU for rental purposes?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best ADU type for rental purposes depends on your property layout, budget, and privacy considerations for both you and your future tenants. Detached ADUs generally offer the most privacy, which can be a strong draw for renters, while garage conversions are often the most cost-effective. Evaluate your property's existing space and how each option impacts tenant access, parking, and noise separation.
